source: BK3 printed pp.63-65 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.69-71; wires image-read on PDF p.71 at 300 dpi; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the wiring and the p.65 rule that light 4 comes ON only at the correct solution; the page prints no setting and no light-4 state for any combination (A/III-TELEVISION is trace-only). Topology: plus enters only at 4V; light 4 sits between 4A/4S and 4B/4-. Switch 4 set 2 LEFT feeds 4U/5V/1V; 1U/1S/2S is fed by switch 1 set 2 LEFT or switch 5 set 2 RIGHT (5W); 2R/2V by switch 1 set 1 RIGHT (1T) or switch 2 set 1 LEFT; 3V/3S by switch 2 set 2 and switch 3 set 2 in opposite positions (2U/3W, 2W/3U); 4S by switches 3 and 4 set 1 in the same position (3R/4R, 3T/4T). So light 4 = S4L AND (S1L OR S5R) AND (S1R OR S2L) AND (S2 != S3) AND (S3 = S4), true only at switches 3, 4 LEFT and 1, 2, 5 RIGHT; with the conventions block (LEFT = watching) that is David and Edward, the unique solution of the p.63 conditions. Script: the printed start (all LEFT, power ON), the solution, each single-switch move away from it and back, then the mirror setting the procedure's parenthetical reading (LEFT = no one watching) would give. The 500 ms advance before each expect lets the lamp finish its thermal transient; the page states no timing. The LEFT contradiction stays [unverified].
